about.title: Suwapatha
about.description: Empowering citizens with seamless digital healthcare, connecting you to government health services efficiently and securely.
about.whatIsDescription: Suwapatha is Sri Lanka's pioneering digital health platform, designed to revolutionize access to public healthcare services. We seamlessly connect citizens with government hospitals and health professionals, making healthcare more accessible, efficient, and patient-centric than ever before. Our platform simplifies everything from appointments to medical records, all while upholding the highest standards of data security and privacy.

unified.title: Unified OPD Channeling
unified.description: Book and manage outpatient department appointments across all government hospitals with ease.

realtime.title: Real-time Queue Status
realtime.description: View live waiting times at clinics and pharmacies, saving you valuable time and effort.

eMedical.title: e-Medical Book
eMedical.description: Access your digital medical records securely, including prescriptions, reports, and health history.

multilingual.title: Multilingual Support
multilingual.description: Available in Sinhala, Tamil, and English to serve all communities across the island.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Features
accessibility.description: Designed for inclusivity with features catering to diverse needs and abilities.

secureIdentity.title: Secure Patient Identity
secureIdentity.description: Verify your identity and access services with a robust and secure digital patient ID system.

about.governanceDescription: At Suwapatha, safeguarding your personal and health information is our utmost priority. We are committed to maintaining the highest standards of privacy and security, adhering strictly to all national regulations and international best practices for data protection. Your trust is paramount, and we employ robust measures to ensure your data remains confidential and secure.

governancePoints.adherence: Adherence to national data privacy laws and healthcare regulations.
governancePoints.encryption: Secure encryption protocols for all patient data transmission and storage.
governancePoints.access: Strict access controls ensuring only authorized personnel can view sensitive information.
governancePoints.policies: Transparent policies on data usage, with explicit patient consent for data sharing.
governancePoints.audits: Regular security audits and updates to protect against emerging threats.
